blocks.orig: Serene Beach Resort is a simple and comfortable accommodation located in the northern part of Dar Es Salaam, a quieter area of this busy city, where the hotel lies facing the Indian Ocean. With 26 spacious rooms, it offers a relaxing time on the seaside with Zanzibari beds, air-conditioning, and ensuite bathrooms in all rooms. During the hot days, you can freshen up in a swimming pool facing the ocean and then pamper your taste buds at the restaurant proposing varied local and international dishes. Direct access to the beach allows you to take a stroll and – if you are an early bird – admire wonderful sunrises!
blocks.html: Facing the Indian Ocean in the northern part of Dar Es Salaam, a calmer district of this bustling city, Serene Beach Resort is a simple, comfortable place to stay. Its 26 roomy rooms all have Zanzibari beds, air-conditioning and ensuite bathrooms, making for a relaxing stay by the sea. On hot days you can cool off in the pool overlooking the ocean, then treat yourself at the restaurant, which offers a varied menu of local and international dishes. With direct beach access you can go for a walk and – if you like to rise early – enjoy beautiful sunrises!
